milestones.title: PR Drain, mesh peers, activity timeline
p5.js ambient visualization and visual polish

issues.title: Trace actual command `majordomus ui`, server startup, routes and developer experience; decide minimal alias or entry path that reuses shared server.
Map Cockpit rendered pages, reusable view helpers, asset bundling, Tailwind/Flowbite/Alpine integration, CSS and JS entry points.
Trace canonical data producers for intent, milestone, issue, PR, CI timings, release/deploy, mesh peers, execution events and available user/repo identity.
Audit current `.ai` invariants and live PR branches; identify conflicting prior UI work and merge candidates.
Capture reproducible baseline screenshots at target widths plus performance/accessibility and current page route coverage.
Define typed overview projection composed from existing capability results, not a new ledger; include origin/provenance and measured timestamps.
Derive overview state and navigation groups from existing registries; detect absent capability and permissions.
Define safe KPI aggregation and trends using measured timestamps/consistent denominator; distinguish current vs historical windows.
Add stable link and action descriptors resolved through existing route/capability metadata, not concatenated client URLs.
Add schema, contract tests and drift checks across CLI/API/MCP/Cockpit for same canonical facts.
Create coherent dark-first desktop shell: fixed-width sidebar, compact top toolbar, main 12-column dashboard and optional right activity rail.
Implement product mark, repository selector, canonical search/command palette, branch/version indicators and meaningful profile state.
Build hero banner and six KPI cards from projection states with skeletons, honest empty states and time semantics.
Implement tablet collapse, mobile drawer and activity rail fold/unfold with keyboard-focus trap/return and scroll ownership.
Extend canonical tokens for spacing/type/surface/shadows/accent only if existing roles insufficient; regenerate all consumers and add visual regression cases.
Derive intent → milestones → issues/PRs → releases → deploys from canonical graph nodes/edges and typed relations, preserving ambiguity and missing edges.
Render server-side accessible node/edge list and status table as source of truth; enhancement only when module loads.
Add lazy Cytoscape rendering, deterministic stable layout, zoom/pan/fit, click navigation, selection synchronization and legend.
Handle hundreds/thousands nodes via clustering, virtualization/scope and user filters without inventing graph edges.
Test graph/list parity, keyboard interaction, CSP/security, narrow screens and JS-disabled fallback.
Map authoritative CI latency telemetry: queue vs execution vs total, p50/p95, sample size, window and source.
Map PR throughput and release cadence from recorded integrations and published releases without synthetic observations.
Create compact chart panels with lazy ECharts imports, shared theme tokens, usable axis labels, legends and accessible data table.
Add range/filter selectors over server-supported query contracts, cancel outdated requests, honest gap/insufficient-data states.
Validate chart-table data parity, timezone/units, performance budgets, reduced motion and responsive layout.
Render PR queue rows with canonical IDs, title, phase, blockers, freshness, assigned agent and safe detail links; statuses only from real enum.
Add authorized PR actions by existing capability input schema and executor; require server-confirmed outcomes and show execution ID.
Render mesh peers from authenticated registry and liveness state; distinguish present, stale, unreachable and unauthorized.
Render activity timeline from execution/evidence stream with durable cursors, idempotent ordering, backpressure and disconnect recovery.
Test action denial/approval, concurrency races, impersonation resistance, stale rows, event gaps and browser reconnect.
Render intent/milestone progress from canonical acceptance/dependency semantics; avoid false completion percentages for blocked milestones.
Implement click-through to intent, issue, PR, worker, run, release and source evidence, with no dead-end dashboard badges.
Unify roadmap/plan labels and version status with current living-site freshness model and avoid duplicate metadata.
Add search and keyboard shortcuts using existing palette/registry; nav must be discovered and deterministically ordered.
Cross-surface integration and snapshot tests for route ownership, broken links, stable state and accessible empty states.
Assess whether a procedural network motif adds information; isolate as low-cost purely decorative enhancement, never live status evidence.
Implement optional p5.js or lightweight Canvas motif only when performance and licensing/asset checks pass; lazy load.
Tune screenshot fidelity: exact hierarchy, panel density, surfaces, rounded cards, cyan/purple/green accent roles and elevation without neon excess.
Harden dark/light responsive contrast, reduced-motion behavior, print, no-WebGL and battery-conscious rendering.
Add asset budgets, motion regression, static-image fallback and high-resolution visual compare checks.
Migrate `.ai` rules/doctrines for derived UI, zero mocks, provenance, measured KPIs, a11y, cross-surface parity and speed budgets.
Wire minimal, fast targeted gates into canonical `.ai/repo/ci/gates.yaml` plus nightly/full depth tests; prove required checks cannot silently be skipped.
Update docs/COCKPIT.md, installation/UI/quickstart/reference, ADR when warranted, capability examples and help/completion generation.
Update GitHub Pages as a public *explanation* and interactive derived demonstration linked to live Cockpit when available; no claim of runtime streaming on static hosting.
Add content provenance and deploy freshness smoke checks, derive/check, page audits, link audits, snapshots and no-stale-claim enforcement.
Integrate validated increments frequently using existing PR drain/mesh governance and evidence; avoid one giant PR.
Analyze canonical versioning/Elm-like surface changes; bump version only when policy requires, not manually by assumption.
Run focused, regression, integration, transport contract, a11y, mobile, security and performance gates, with exact commands/evidence.
Release and deploy through existing verified pipelines with provenance/health; roll out incrementally with rollback path.
Dogfood via `majordomus ui` on self repo AND clean consumer repo; verify data parity, interactions and final visual differences against reference.
